claims.text: The car pulls forward out of the dark.
The source clip shows a driver walking around a car in a concrete road tunnel lit by overhead sodium strip lights.
The source clip is a live-action, cinematic medium-wide shot in which the driver crosses frame left to right.
The driver in the source clip wears a grey overall, and the car is black with a carbon-fibre body.
The picture asset shows a driver in a red jacket on an empty showroom floor.
Dust drifts in the strip-light beams and shallow puddles on the concrete hold thin vertical reflections.
A restrained low synth drone with a soft metallic shimmer sits quietly beneath the tunnel sound.

soundscape: Tunnel room tone with a distant engine idle settling into a low, even rev, and dry tyre roll on scuffed concrete.
music: A restrained low synth drone with a soft metallic shimmer, held quietly under the scene and never rising above the engine.

description.text: A concrete road tunnel stretches away into unlit depth, its walls pale grey and faintly damp, two long rows of sodium strip lights burning overhead and fading toward the far end.
rests at the very back of that darkness, only a thin rim of light tracing the roof line of its carbon-fibre body.
stands clear of the near lane with his weight settled on one hip, and

stays visible further back inside the bay, the red jacket bright against the shadowed concrete. Dust hangs in the beams, and the floor is scuffed with old tyre marks and shallow puddles that hold thin vertical reflections of the lights.
For the first moments the frame is mostly darkness and the bare geometry of the tunnel; the strips overhead burn a dull amber haze, and the far bay where
waits is almost black, its panels giving back only a wet-looking glint along the flank.
Low tunnel room tone with a faint idle carrying from the far bay and a thin drip of water on concrete.
rolls forward out of the dark, wheels turning slowly over the scuffed floor, headlights still dead so the body reads as a darker mass pressing against the amber haze.
As it advances, the leading edge of the

eases into the overhead sodium light; highlights slide along the carbon-fibre panels, the windscreen takes a flat amber sheen, and the car grows steadily larger in the frame while the light behind it stays unbroken.
shifts his stance and turns to track the car as it passes into the light, one hand loose at his side, his grey overall picking up a warmer edge from the strips above.
The engine lifts to a low, even rev and the tyre roll thickens across the concrete as the car keeps coming toward the near lane.
